title: BlockyBird
description: Flappy Bird, recreated in Minecraft as a GUI mini-game.
body:
# BlockyBird

Play a simple Flappy Bird–style mini-game right inside Minecraft.
Run `/blockybird` to open the GUI and see how far you can get.
